name: Carlos C. Aguila
tagline: Top rated Estate Planning & Probate attorney in Miami, Florida
about: Carlos C. Aguila is an attorney who represents clients in the Miami, Florida area. Carlos Aguila is recognized by peers and was selected to Rising Stars for 2019 - 2024, 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

Carlos Aguila chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended Ave Maria School of Law and graduated in 2013. Carlos Aguila passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 2014.
He represents clients with Estate Planning & Probate issues in Florida. He also represents clients with Estate & Trust Litigation issues.

Being selected to Rising Stars is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Rising Stars, Carlos Aguila has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
